The '''Aleen Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The system contained the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]].
